crossRefs.note: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease…
For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But…
that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease, until the matter should come…
Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was…
in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

people.name: Darius
people.line: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Persia
people.line: An empire that ruled over the exiled Jews

translations.web: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
translations.bsb: Thus the construction of the house of God in Jerusalem ceased, and it remained at a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
translations.kjv: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
translations.asv: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem; and it ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
